title: Making Software Development More Diverse and Inclusive: Key Themes, Challenges, and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation using the 1-2-4-ALL collaborative discussion method during an academic workshop to identify the overlapping systemic challenges faced by developers with multiple marginalized identities.

Expert consensus and scenario mapping (1-2-4-ALL method) to identify economic and geographic barriers in software engineering, proposing the integration of large-scale societal surveys to address systemic exclusion.

Literature synthesis and expert discussion evaluating the disparate impacts and performance of Generative AI coding assistants on non-native English speakers and non-WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) populations.
Qualitative workshop discussion identifying the lack of inclusive metrics and the need to design AI interaction styles (e.g., tinkering) that accommodate diverse cognitive processing methods.
